# Commit map: hashes before and after the edit of commit-message trailers (2026-11-14)
#
# On 2026-11-14 the commit messages of the public history were rewritten once: in every
# 'Co-Authored-By: Claude <model> <version> <noreply@anthropic.com>' trailer the e-mail address
# was removed (the model name stays). File contents, author and committer names, e-mails and dates
# are unchanged (every commit keeps its tree); the SSH signatures of the original commits could not
# be kept. Tag v1.2.0 was moved to the rewritten release commit; the Zenodo archive
# (10.5281/zenodo.24203510) holds the same files.
#
# Commit hashes cited inside files committed before the edit (experiment protocols, notes, results,
# documentation, labels such as 0.4-legacy@6fea4d6) refer to the left column.
